_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: A 0% directional hit rate over 60 windows defines a textbook coil where a forced directional guess is statistically reckless, making HOLD with high conviction the skilled call until the coil breaks.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD awaiting breakers while the narrative writer implies an imminent UP reversal; the judge sides with the analyst's empirically-backed coil read.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows recovers above 30 with btc_momentum_30d holding > 55 and funding < 0.005%
next_move.invalidated_if: etf_flows remains < 10 for 3+ days with VIX > 70 and funding turning negative
